values: Set up canonical Git repo, branches, deployment and environment structure
Architecture diagram, repo layout and deployment approach
Repo and deployment guidance available. Canonical remote, branch policy and architecture diagram need owner confirmation.
Keep Karun's existing UI; use reference prototype only.
Confirm canonical repo and branch policy, then attach approved architecture diagram.
Define MongoDB collections, indexes, transactions/ledger approach and migration seeds
MongoDB model definitions, transactional engine and local seeding are present. Migration plan and deployed database evidence remain open.
One persistent database across all six weeks.
Review indexes, migration runbook and replica-set configuration.
Implement authentication, secure sessions and server-side role/team/cohort isolation
Session and role/cohort guards are implemented. Isolated coverage does not establish live security configuration.
Gamer, MC, CC; TL is temporary Gamer overlay.
Verify exact-build sign-in, secure cookies and role boundaries in an approved environment.
Implement Express API service and persistence/repository patterns
Shared APIs and MongoDB persistence are present via Next.js route handlers. Express is a tracker requirement and differs from the implementation.
Obtain approval for Next.js route handlers or implement the required Express service.
Implement time/calendar/day release engine and Saturday/weekly progression rules
Week 1 release and programme progression plus pilot calendar logic are present. Full live scheduling remains open.
Demonstrate the release, Saturday and next-sprint transitions on the approved build.
Implement task state machine, TT dependency, handoff and deadline calculations
Isolated task lifecycle, prerequisites and timed handover passed. Deadline and reminder code is present.
One working-hour transit and two-working-hour delay reminder.
Demo the task-to-review journey, handover timer and delay notification.
Implement review SLAs, independent reassessment, approval and immutable audit logs
Independent reviews, reassessment and audit records have local coverage. Immutability and the lifetime policy need formal verification.
Verify SLA, three reassessments and audit write protections against the policy.
Implement scoring/assessment, energy/lives and trophy ledgers
Scoring, energy and recognition ledgers are present with isolated pilot coverage.
Reconcile all 13 criteria, core weights and separate recognition against approved samples.
Implement CL release/assignment controls and weekly cap calculation
CL controls are present. The default three and above-82 cap of five passed in isolation.
Prev week team core mean >82 =>5 else3; max2 active.
Witness assignment and the two-active limit in the approved environment.
Implement Help Pass consumption, sponsored support and earned AI Help rules
Isolated tests passed for free help, one lifetime sponsorship, earned AI Help and carry-forward.
3 daily discoveries OR 1 weekly quest =>1 AI Help; max1/week.
Confirm end-to-end Gamer and MC browser experience before sign-off.
Implement secure batch export/import contracts for AI assessments
JSON/CSV export/import service with review status
Export/import, marks handling and human review logic exist. Exact data contracts and live AI exchange require validation.
Validate schemas, scope, redaction and human approval with approved fixtures.
Implement event notifications and reliable scheduled reminder generation
In-app reminders and an authenticated scheduler entry point are available. Scheduled worker has isolated coverage.
Verify protected scheduling, delivery, retries and operations ownership.
Integrate existing UI with real login/session and role-specific navigation
Role-specific app views and session code are present. Exact-build live dashboard verification remains open.
Demonstrate Gamer, MC and CC sign-in and navigation on the approved build.
Connect cohort/team/roster setup and role rotations to real APIs
Team management, roster and rotation code and tests are available.
Five teams x five Gamers per MC.
Demo cohort setup, five teams of five and role rotation using fictional data.
Connect Week 1 day content, baseline/readiness and Saturday clearance forms
Week 1 admin and release forms and programme transition tests are available.
Verify the approved curriculum and complete a Week 1 browser journey.
Connect sprint board, task detail, statuses, evidence and TL overlay
Task board, evidence and role overlay are present. Real private Blob round trip is deferred.
Maintain locked Sprint 1 and 2 card IDs.
Verify the board in browser and run the private evidence round trip before sign-off.
Connect What's Due Today, handovers, Daily Spark and reminder views
Daily dashboard, handovers, Spark and reminders are present with isolated coverage.
No star for viewing; factual question required.
Verify the due view, factual Spark question and reminders in browser.
Connect Help Desk, ticket views, Help Pass and sponsor/AI assistance UI
Support UI and entitlement rules are available. Isolated Help Pass tests passed.
Have Gamer and MC witness free help, sponsorship and earned AI Help in browser.
Connect task review, approval queues, reassessment, EOD and journaling
Live MC/CC and Gamer review journeys
Review queues, reassessment and team EOD workflow are implemented with isolated tests.
Witness review, appeals, EOD and journal role boundaries in browser.
Connect rewards, score history, energy and competency dashboards
Score and energy views and persisted ledgers are present. Exact-build values need independent reconciliation.
Reconcile role-specific displays with stored records and approved scoring.
Load approved Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 cards, seven checks each and CL bank
Core sprint manifests are available. Fictional Team A has an isolated Key 2 baseline record.
Verify seeded cards, seven gates per sprint and CL bank on the intended cohort.
Load Week 4 Sprint 3: 20 cards, seven acceptance checks and roles
Frozen Sprint 3 import and timed dependency rehearsal passed. Key 3 remains pending.
Review seven gates and five individual defences before recording Key 3.
Map/rehearse four reversible incident patches for student MERN projects
Four prepared incident implementations + rollback scripts
INC-04 was reproduced and rolled back on a disposable gateway. INC-01 through INC-03 team mappings remain open.
MC selects; CC approves; operator applies. No public insecure deployment.
Obtain approved mappings and rehearse the remaining incident and rollback cases in isolation.
Configure incident selection and CC approval mapping into existing workflow
INC-04 selection and approval were operator-confirmed. Dedicated in-app selection, decline and mapping workflow remains unverified.
Demonstrate MC selection, CC approve/decline and scoped Gamer disclosure.
Load Week 5 Sprint 4: 20 cards, four testing guides and seven gates
Twenty cards, five UAT cards and seven gates loaded in isolation. Four testing guide paths need browser validation.
Validate all four guides and collect gate-specific evidence. Key 4 remains pending.
Configure protected UAT rotation, task guides and evidence capture
Five UAT assignments and linked help prompts
All five assignments are configured. Early start defect passed server retests and self-approval was rejected. Independent sessions remain open.
Run five protected browser sessions and retain CC-reviewed UAT findings.
Load Week 6 Sprint 5: 20 cards, seven checks and five persona briefs
Twenty Sprint 5 cards loaded with five DEMO cards and prerequisite checks in fixtures. Live demos and gate decisions remain open.
Validate persona briefs and witness five demos and private defences.
Import 60 optional Phase 2 task cards and dependency chains
All 60 optional cards, dependency graphs and MC allocations passed isolated checks.
MC can assign without fixed Gamer mapping.
Review the assignment bank against the approved extension branch.
Configure Phase 2 unlock eligibility and separate bonus achievements
Pre-Key 5 and prior-level guards, separate extension bonus and duplicate protection passed isolated checks.
Core sprint accepted first; preserve core scores.
Witness an optional journey end to end and reconcile the separate bonus ledger.
Prepare provider sandbox and API/webhook reference for advanced student exercises
No isolated provider sandbox or extension build was available for payment QA.
No live card data or real payments.
Provision test-only provider credentials, callback contract and extension deployment.
Define and implement export bundles for five codebases plus 25 Gamer dossiers
A five-Gamer export passed in isolation. Five real code snapshots and 25 dossiers were not exercised together.
No secrets or private unnecessary data.
Run a fictional five-team export and review source linkage, completeness and redaction.
Connect AI question import and MC/CC override to existing approvals
Advisory question, findings and provisional assessment import passed in isolation. Exact MC edit and CC approval path remains open.
Verify an approved question revision reaches the assessor and is auditable.
Configure five parallel persona assessment rounds and finalist records
Five-arena configuration and the staffing guard passed with fixtures. Concurrent rooms and finalist workflow remain open.
Assign five assessors, exercise parallel rooms and audit finalist selection.
Configure 13+2+4+1 awards and MC/CC recipient override records
Award recommendation, CC approval and one-criterion-per-Gamer guard have isolated coverage. Full allocation and override cases remain open.
Max one of 13 criterion awards normally.
Execute all award classes, override audit and score-invariance checks.
Generate two-page Capability Passport with criterion evidence and bonuses separate
Private Passport issuance metadata and access passed with simulated storage. Staff prepare PDFs. Rendering and real Blob delivery remain open.
Validate the exact two-page PDF and verified private delivery.
Generate minimal Certificate of Assessed Completion with eligibility and ID
Certificate review, eligibility and private issuance were tested with simulated storage. Exact PDF generation and wording remain open.
Verify the finished certificate wording, fields and identifier, then run private delivery.
Merge Part A/B configurations into one live platform and deploy stable release
A unified local implementation and build are available. Live merge, deployment and end-to-end verification were outside the isolated work.
Close acceptance gaps, obtain release approval and verify the intended deployment.

The entry records this local evidence review. It does not record owner or CC sign-off.
